title: Political Engine
description:
Political Engine 0.7.0 - Experimental release
AI-driven political correspondence, diplomacy and warfare for SkyrimNet. Exchange letters with jarls, negotiate trade and peace, command troops, and manage territories, resources and buildings through an interactive campaign map.

Continuation of Political Letters: legacy plugin names are preserved for save compatibility. Back up your save before updating.
author: sixteenth
changelog:
### **NEW in 0.7.0:**

  **- Separate puppet treasuries and resources, transfers between realms, and independent AI self-government toggles.**
  
  **- Commander position. Stewards handle economy and trade, commanders handle armies and reconnaissance, and rulers handle both.**
  
  **- Dialogue orders for construction, recruitment, troop movement, reconnaissance, and trade agreement cancellation.**
    _Just say them, what to do_
  
  **- Archers and battlemages, troop composition controls, new military buildings, and equipment upgrades for existing soldiers.**
    _MORE FIGHTERS - MORE CHAOS_  

  **- Fog of war and covert scouting, with detection checked once per complete campaign round.**
    _KGB never sleeps_  

  **- Initial delegation system: representative travel, invitations, meetings, return reports, and neutral camps.**
    _They are afraid of you..._  

  **- Optional realm briefings in officials’ biographies covering armies, economy, buildings, wars, and trade.**
  
  **- Separated field battle formations and a configurable corpse limit, defaulting to 30.**
    _More FPS, more soldiers you can add_  

  **- Reorganized settings, clearer custom realm placement instructions, updated API, and revised vanilla NPC office assignments.**
  
  **- Realm Management: controlled realms, offices, private puppet links, delegation stages, mission cancellation, battle diagnostics and a saved results journal.**
  
  **- MageLightUI support**
  _A HUGE thank to Whyregister for fixes_ 

  **- New API with overwrite ability.**

  **- A lot of bug fixes, perfomance and tokens usage upgrades** 

Also, you can check guide on https://github.com/L-Sixteenth/Political-Engine-Releases
